checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images, no cover/closing

must.why: All texts correct and in order.
Desk, phone with bell, checklist, timer, coffee cup all relevant, though the bell isn't clearly muted and the timer looks odd.

must.item: Shared clean blue-and-white design, readable unclipped text
must.why: Consistent blue on white; text is readable. Number size, illustration size and blue shades vary.

faults.what: Inconsistent sizes: the numerals and illustrations vary a lot across slides. The 4 is huge and the checklist and cup are tiny. Text position shifts between slides.
The bell on slide 2 is small and blobby, with no clear mute slash. The timer on slide 4 looks like an odd toaster-like device. The desk is a sketchy line style that differs from the others.
The illustrations are small, leaving large empty space on slides 3 and 5.

summary: Five clean blue-and-white 4:5 slides came out with correct text, numbering and relevant illustrations, but the sizes and styles are inconsistent and some illustrations are tiny or odd.
